name: 北森考勤休假
description_zh: 查询考勤与休假数据。支持查看假期余额、考勤打卡记录、排班信息、加班、公出、出差、休假记录和调休假余额。随时掌握出勤状态。
description_en: Query attendance and leave data. View leave balances, clock-in/out records, shift schedules, overtime, business trips, leave history, and compensatory leave. Stay on top of attendance at all times.
